verbatim_quote.original: it must full automatic and you need install it globaly to my ~/.local/bin or some where i and also i just run it like rotate or something or rr it auto roatte current active.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: It must be fully automatic, and you need to install it globally to my ~/.local/bin or somewhere, and I just run it like rotate or something, or rr — it auto-rotates the current active node.

extracted_decision.summary: Manual rotate helper must be a global zero-argument command (rr) that auto-detects and rotates the currently active node.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager hits rate limits mid-work and cannot wait for the timer or look up node names.
alternatives: skip NAME with explicit node name only
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Launcher lives outside the repo (home dir), so repo commits carry only the subcommand, not the install.
